notes.title: Getting ready for launch

Since we are very close to Bandit Brawler release we decide to take down the demo as it doesn't reflect the features we have in the final version. We'll see if we will put it back online because making a seperate build for a demo version, considering we are an indie team, is an effort on our behalf and we would rather place that energy in the final game.

Getting back to work.

notes.title: Offical release date and free keys
notes.notes:
Hello, future bandits!

There's been a lot of activities around the game lately so we have prepared a summary for you.

First of all, as you probably noticed, we've changed the games name to better reflect its vibe and gameplay. Though the game initially started as a simulation concept, as we were working on it, it leaned more and more towards being a wacky melee-open-world-platformer-comedy.

Secondly, we did plan to release Bandit Brawler at the beginning of June, but it took some time to get through Steams certification process. Along the way, we managed to organize support from a couple of friendly studios to help us with cross-promotion of Bandit Brawler, and finally decided to set the launch date for 21st of June 2023.

Moreover, if you are a curator and would like to receive a key for the full Bandit Brawler game, please send a request through our Keymailer account [url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/dda6a09a]here[/url]  

Lastly, Bandit Brawler will support English, Polish, Spanish, French, German and Italian languages at launch. These are not our native lounges and we did our best so please be generous when playing the game ;-)

Thank you for being with us so far. We have put a lot of effort and time into Bandit Brawler. This is our first 3D game that we publish independently as Titanite Games. We are very excited to be finally publishing it through Steam.

Please support the game by sharing liking this post, sharing it and following us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/TitaniteGames]here[/url]

Let's make pigs fly :-)

Titanite Games,

notes.title: New name, new trailer, demo update
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow Bandits,

As we are getting closer to releasing the game, we have a few announcements!

First of all, we are changing the name of the game. Bandit Brawler better reflects the game genre and vibe. Since we will be punching a lot of suckers in the face, it only made sense.

Bandit Simulator is dead. Long live[b] Bandit Brawler[/b].

Secondly, there is a large update coming for the demo tomorrow. The list of [b]fixes[/b] includes:
- graphical fixes
- bleeding mechanic fix
- adjustments to UI
- bugs hunted
- changes in some NPC behavior
- better chest contents
- urinating on folks works better now
- adjustments to the quests UI

Also, we are very proud to introduce to you our [b]launch trailer[/b] which you can watch on the game's Steam profile.

Enjoy! The game's coming very soon!

Titanite Games

notes.title: Demo maintenance
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We've decided to take down Bandit's demo for the time being as it needs more polish and reworks. We are making efforts to make the UX as smooth as possible and were not able to do that until now. The user experience, on boarding and game's presentation are of crucial importance for us. 

Apologies not hitting the mark yet. :(

We are working on language versions for the game, namely [b]French, German, Spanish and Italian[/b] and hope to give you access to a new demo very soon. There will be a separate announcement about it.

To be honest, working on this game is a struggle, since it has inherited many technological issues from the early stages of development which were overlooked for some time.

Still, we are determined to deliver Bandit Simulator (which is hardly a simulation game at this point ;) to you and provide you with a fun couple of hours of gameplay. Since you're here with us, you deserve it.

If you have any ideas you'd like us to include in the game, please let us know.

Thanks for your support so far!

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Dev Blog 10
notes.notes:
Fellow Bandits,

At Titanite Games we are still hard at work on Bandit Simulator and the dedication of our team is finally paying off. We want you all to enjoy a good looking fantasy game where you can get your freak on and cause some damage.

A real bandit doesn’t give a f*ck and just does whatever he feels like doing. This means stealing, robbing, pickpocketing and generally stirring sh*t up. What better of doing so is there than giving the authority the finger? Remember: a single guard is no match for you, but if he's got company you might need to sweat a little.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/5be247f76631c723a2b73d842f6f2c076a2cf0de.gif[/img]

In Bandit Simulator the world is full of peculiar locations to be explored and looted. Look around, explore, discover and reap the rewards. Be careful though: some places hide secrets that will test your skills and patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/b008dcac669c05cdbc57ee3e99adcff7a5b0b708.png[/img]

The beautiful world of Bandit Simulator is alive and ready to be played with. If you play your cards right, earn your Bandits Respect and score enough cash, you can cause some real damage with powerfull explosives. Take aim, wait for the right moment and send those pesky guards flying!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/eb359b9292ad62f79a39f69f272dfdc085bd96da.gif[/img]

Bandit Simulator will take part in the upcoming Steam Festival in October so all you bandits will have the opportunity to lay your hands on the game and take advantage of some of its features. 

Stay tuned for another update!

notes.title: Bandit Simulator Dev Blog #9
notes.notes:
After all the evil doings, fist fights and kicking hen into the air, it’s to time to have some fun at the annual beer festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/4c17ea90c15de790c9798d185118e9c61cd07dce.png[/img]

To access the festival you’ll need to earn some Bandits Respect first, but once your there, you’ll gain access to a couple of unique quests. Complete them all and you might just receive a new cool weapon or ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/74ea9f691306626eb1e68c0782eaaa26005bafe9.jpg[/img]

Besides, this is a beer festival so there's more than opportunity to check out your skills after a pint or two.  Think you're a good brawler? We'll see how you handle your opponents when both of you are in a happy place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/bf9df212a0a723dc536a264208ffddd83c32978d.jpg[/img]

How about shooting your bow? Let's jus say that hitting a shack from 15 metres might become a challenge once you get dizzy-happy.

The Beer Festival is yet another opportunity to inflict some damage on innocent pieces of pottery and  NPC's. Just make sure the guards can't see you.

As for the future, we are preparing an update on the melee combat and the cool things all of you bandits will be able to do in Bandit Simulator.

Thanks for reading this post! WOULD YOU KINDLY ;) ;) share the post with your buddies and help us spread the word about the game?

Cheers!

notes.title: Bandit Simulator Dev Blog #8
notes.notes:
Bandits life is not always rainbows and sunshine. In fact, it comes with a set of cons. Dangerous working conditions, no health insurance and the social stigma of being the bad guy. 

Well, we can’t make people like bandits but we can make sure that as a bandit you will at least have some dirty fun. And you get to punch people. Hard. Like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/fbe45e93567fe6a0349a802c805ac37f17ef082c.gif[/img]

We made sure that the environment responds to your menacing actions. Every time you land a final slap on a guards stupid mug and send him flying you can count on wrecking some havoc as a result. You don’t mess with a pi**ed off bandit!

Remember the movie John Wick? Remember how he supposedly was able to kill three men with a pencil?

Bandit Simulator tops that. You can kill a man with nothing more than a well placed carrot throw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/8133f28d3bf988487725d2e47a0dfb3bad5190f8.gif[/img]

Most items in the game can become your weapon to be thrown at your opponent. Even animals. (Though as developers we don’t encourage making animal projectiles)

That’s it for the current update. Your support means a world to our dev team, so please, leave a like, leave a comment and add Bandit Simulator to your wishlist now! 

More info coming soon!

notes.title: Bandit Simulator Dev Blog #7
notes.notes:
Fellow bandits and rascals!

Don’t you sometimes feel like just breaking things around you? Luckly, after months of thorough research, surveys and experimentations, we came to a conclusion:

Yes, [b]breaking stuff is fun[/b]. Now hold, me beer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/9e6af596796a76accd02a3e18f90d5dffeeb055b.gif[/img]

Since [b]Bandit Simulator[/b] is the first and only of its kind, it only made sense to allow for some creative use of one's fists, punches, kicks and flying objects. We’ve added a dozen of destructibles to the game which you can tear to pieces at your will. Got stuck during a quest? No worry, just roam around and kick the sh*t out those filthy barrels and vases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/7ef4ab5d580d0142c9b3a47c287786fe803c0b30.gif[/img]

Need more gold to attend the annual Beer Festival? Look for marked crates, show ‘em whose the boss and collect the drop.

Oh, did we mention that the items you destroy often hold [b]collectibles[/b] which you can exchange for cash later on? Well, they do, and you never know what you might find by headbutting a lonely crate sitting on a roof or a tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/55c87ffd9cb88215e68f8c7f74ccda49898ccb02.gif[/img]

Of course, punching a crate is not as fun as kicking a guard in the n*ts flying, but we’ll get to the [b]new melee mechanics [/b]in the future.

For now, like to post share it, add the game to your wishlist and feel free to ask us any question you might have.

Next update coming soon!
